headline: Cut the Rope
title: Cut the Rope Facts | Om Nom's Candy Hit | Classic Games
video_script: Cut the Rope was released on October fourth, twenty ten, by the studio ZeptoLab. You cut ropes to drop candy into the mouth of a small green creature called Om Nom, while collecting stars. Ten days after launch, its publisher Chillingo said it had sold one million copies. The series has since passed one billion downloads. Which Om Nom level stopped you the longest? Comment below!
description: Cut the Rope by ZeptoLab released October 4, 2010, sold one million copies in 10 days, and the series passed one billion downloads. Sources: Wikipedia, Game Informer, PocketGamer.
joke: Om Nom only asks for candy, which is more honest than most of us.
